name: 1-alfaro
description: 1-Alfaro is a wedding venue offering weekend lunch and Friday, Saturday, and Sunday dinner packages. The venue features an award-winning culinary team, an Alfresco area for solemnization and cocktail receptions, and a dining room for wedding receptions. The venue provides Italian-inspired cuisine with carefully crafted menus for each occasion.

name: 1-altitude Coast Rooftop Bar
description: 1-Altitude Coast is a wedding venue offering weekend lunch and dinner packages (Friday, Saturday, Sunday) with award-winning culinary team. Features exclusive use of designated event space and pool deck for solemnization and cocktail reception. Located on an island with complimentary island entry for all guests. Offers thoughtfully curated wedding banquets with various menu options including canapes, appetisers, soups, mains and desserts.

name: 1-arden
description: 1-Arden is a wedding venue offering Weekend Lunch, Saturday Dinner, and Sunday Dinner packages. The venue features an innovative and award-winning culinary team offering Australian and Asian 4-course menus. Packages include exclusive usage of allocated areas, champagne fountains, floral centrepieces, dedicated wedding planners, private bridal rooms, and in-house audio & visual equipment. Dinner packages include complimentary hotel stays at The Fullerton Hotel.

name: 1-atico
description: 1-Atico is a wedding venue offering both lunch and dinner wedding banquet packages. The venue features an award-winning culinary team, dedicated wedding planners, and elegant event spaces. They offer 4-course lunch and dinner menus with multiple menu options (Menu A and Menu B), champagne fountains, floral centrepieces, and various wedding amenities including a private bridal room.

name: 1-flowerhill
description: 1-Flowerhill is a wedding venue offering two exclusive packages: Camille Exclusive and 6 Imbiah Exclusive. The venue features outdoor courtyard for solemnization and cocktail reception, private bridal changing room, and in-house audio and visual equipment. It is located on Sentosa Island and offers complimentary island entry for all guests. The venue provides award-winning culinary team prepared banquets with Western-style plated menus.

rooms.room_name: Entire Venue (Camille Restaurant + Wildseed Bar and Grill)

name: Aloft Singapore Novena
description: Aloft Singapore Novena is a hotel venue offering wedding lunch and dinner packages with authentic Chinese cuisine. The venue features two function rooms: the Balestier Ballroom and the Zhongshan Room. Packages include personalised 8-course Chinese set menus, beverages, themed decorations, accommodation, and special perks. Solemnisation can be arranged at the outdoor event lawn at an additional charge or complimentarily within the same venue as the wedding reception.

name: Altro Zafferano
description: Altro Zafferano is an Italian fine dining restaurant that offers event and wedding packages. The venue can accommodate up to 250 guests in a single space, or split into two separate groups with one group in a private room and the other in the main dining area. They offer a 4-course set menu package at $128 per person with Italian cuisine including appetizers, pasta, main courses, and desserts. Minimum spending requirement is $15,000++.

name: Amara Sanctuary Sentosa
description: Amara Sanctuary Sentosa is a wedding and events venue located on Sentosa Island, Singapore. It features a 3.8-hectare tropical garden setting with multiple wedding venues including the Glass Pavilion (adorned with antique chapel bells and a cascading waterfall, seating up to 30 guests), the Spiral Stairway (featuring a spiraled white marble stairway and grand piano), and the Grand Ballroom (a pillarless six-metre-high ballroom accommodating up to 400 guests, housed in a magnificent two-storey all-glass building with an opulent foyer and private entrance). The resort is pet-friendly and fully wheelchair accessible.

name: Amara Singapore
description: Amara Singapore is a hotel venue offering wedding receptions and events. Their function venues have undergone a facelift with a new and refreshed look, featuring an 8.9 meters LED Wall. They offer wedding packages for both lunch and dinner receptions, accommodating ROM ceremonies and wedding banquets. The ballroom is located at Level 3.

packages.package_name: YOU'RE MY HEART, YOU'RE MY SOUL

name: Andaz Singapore
description: Andaz Singapore is a hotel featuring a dedicated events floor called 'Alley on 3' with two signature wedding venues: The Glasshouse and Garden Studio. The Glasshouse is a daylight-filled, residential-style ballroom with floor-to-ceiling windows on three sides, perfect for celebrations surrounded by loved ones. Garden Studio is an intimate venue overlooking an outdoor garden, ideal for solemnizations and cozy celebrations that feel warm, personal and naturally connected. The hotel is inspired by #TogetherByHyatt, believing in creating heartfelt connections and curating experiences that reflect each couple's story. Award-winning property: 2025 Singapore Hotel Sustainability Award, 2025 Travel + Leisure Luxury Awards Asia Pacific – Best Hotel, Pool & General Manager, 2025 Travel + Leisure 500 Best Hotels in the World, 2025 DestinAsian Readers' Choice Awards – #7 Best Hotel in Singapore.

name: Artemis
description: Situated 40 floors atop Singapore's most iconic green landmark CapitaGreen, Artemis offers unparalleled panoramic views of the stunning Singapore skyline and Marina Bay. The venue features a Rooftop Forest Garden for picturesque solemnisations, a Main Dining Hall with floor-to-ceiling glass windows showcasing the panoramic view of the Marina Bay skyline, and an outdoor Sky Terrace bar. Artemis offers exquisite, produce-driven Mediterranean cuisine and impeccable service to make your special day an enchanting and flawless occasion.

name: Atlas Bar At Parkview Square
address: Parkview Square, 600 North Bridge Road, Singapore
description: ATLAS is a celebration of the grand Art Deco lobbies of Europe and of the era's rich culinary and beverage traditions. Guests enjoy brilliant all-day and night dining and drinking. ATLAS offers unforgettable events tailored specifically to your needs - from once-in-a-lifetime celebrations to intimate gatherings. The venue features multiple event spaces including The Stage, The Nook, and full venue Takeover options. Located in Parkview Square, the venue is known for its iconic Gin Tower and Art Deco aesthetic.

name: Beaulieu House (sembawang Seafood Paradise)
description: Beaulieu House is a waterfront wedding venue in Singapore operated by Sembawang Seafood Paradise Pte Ltd. It offers multiple rooms and halls of different sizes, outdoor solemnization areas with sea views, and both Chinese banquet and international buffet wedding packages. The venue features elegant setup with dining wares, cloth napkins, and complimentary amenities for larger bookings.

name: Botanico At The Summerhouse
description: The Summerhouse is a wedding venue nestled in lush surrounds of greens and floral hues, featuring a Garden Gazebo and Courtyard for solemnization ceremonies, and a Dining Hall & Balcony for receptions. The venue evokes a sense of homely yet stylish comfort with timberwork and fretwork conveying classic elegance of clean geometric lines. The upper-story dining hall features a mirrored ceiling of tapered and angled panes. The culinary team expertly blends the sizzle of the grill with Asian cuisine, committed to the farm-to-table concept sourcing the freshest ingredients.

name: Capella Singapore
description: Capella Singapore is a luxury hotel nestled within 30 acres of lush greenery with views of the South China Sea on Sentosa Island. It has been hosting dream weddings since 2009 and features two stunning wedding venues: the Grand Ballroom (the only circular-shaped ballroom in Singapore with a glass-dome skylight, glass artpiece, and an 80 sqm LED Wall) and the Sentosa Room (with floor to ceiling glass panes offering views of the South China Sea and tropical lush greenery, along with a dedicated foyer area for cocktail reception). Winner of Travel + Leisure's World's Best Hotel Brand Awards 2023 to 2025.

name: Carlton Hotel Singapore
description: Carlton Hotel Singapore is a hotel venue offering wedding packages in the Esplanade Room and Empress Ballroom. The hotel features transformed Empress Ballrooms with a refreshed modern aesthetic, enhanced lighting, refined architectural details, and LED screens. Wedding packages start from $1,598++ per table of 10. The hotel also hosts wedding workshops and offers solemnisation and tea ceremony spaces.

name: Changi Cove Hotel
description: Changi Cove is a boutique conference centre and hotel offering a unique destination experience with modern contemporary venues set in nature. Their wedding series, The Wedding Naturalist, is custom-tailored with bespoke inclusions, menus, and natural hospitality. The venue features an Auditorium, The Conservatory, and a Sky Deck & Guest Lounge, surrounded by lush greenery.

name: Chijmes Hall Singapore
description: Watabe Wedding manages two heritage halls in Singapore - CHIJMES Hall and Alcove at Caldwell House. These historic venues offer a stunning setting for weddings and events, with both indoor and outdoor options available. The venues are located within the CHIJMES premise at 30 Victoria Street, Singapore.

packages.package_name: Modern Chinese 5-Course (Enhancement Option 2, Min 120 + Live Station)

name: Chinese Swimming Club
description: Fu Lin Men is a Cantonese dining restaurant group by Passion Restaurants Pte Ltd, offering wedding banquet and solemnization packages. They have multiple branches including Chinese Swimming Club (CSC), Temasek Club (TC), and Fu Lin Men Grandeur at Novotel Singapore on Kitchener (NSK). They offer various wedding packages including A Lifetime Promise, Blissful Marriage, Cherished Love, and Perfect Matrimony packages, as well as Solemnization Packages A, B, and C. Note: Fu Lin Men Grandeur at Novotel Singapore on Kitchener accepts bookings only until 30 June 2026.

name: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine
description: Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine is part of the Zui (醉) Teochew Cuisine group, a tribute to the timeless culinary heritage of one of Singapore's founding Chinese dialect groups. Located at Keng Lee Road, the venue offers both solemnisation and wedding banquet packages featuring authentic Teochew cuisine crafted by a Master Chef and culinary team. The venue features spacious ballrooms and function rooms equipped with facilities like bridal rooms, projectors, stages, and LED display panels. It is a Brides Preferred Banquet Venues Winner 2024.

name: Civil Service Club @ Bukit Batok
description: Civil Service Club (CSC) is a multi-location club in Singapore with clubhouses at Bukit Batok, Tessensohn, Changi, and Loyang. The venues offer various event spaces for weddings, ROM ceremonies, corporate events, and social functions. CSC @ Bukit Batok features the Orchid Room, Jasmine Room, Foyer, and Dance Studio. CSC @ Changi offers Function Rooms, Event Lawn, and access to the Seaview Ballroom (operated by tenant Muslim Delights). External caterers are allowed with a $150 surcharge; a list of approved caterers is provided.

packages.package_name: 8-Course Chinese (Lobster, Bird's Nest & Superior Shark's Fin)

name: Civil Service Club @ Changi
description: Civil Service Club at Changi (CSC @ Changi) is a clubhouse offering multiple event spaces including a Banquet Hall (tenant), Seaview Ballroom, Function Rooms, and an Event Lawn. The venue is located at 2 Netheravon Road, Singapore. The Event Lawn is an open space concept with no alternative venue in the event of bad weather.

name: Claudine Restaurant
description: Claudine is a French neo-brasserie in Dempsey Hill by award-winning Chef-Patron Julien Royer and The Lo & Behold Group. Two distinct dining experiences invite guests to savour life's simple pleasures: a grand Dining Room set within a beautifully preserved colonial chapel (restored 1930s chapel), where celebrations naturally unfold; and La Terrace, a welcoming retreat perfect for unhurried moments. As featured in MICHELIN Guide Singapore Restaurants 2025, Tatler Best 20 Restaurants 2024 & 2025, and Asia's 50 Best Restaurants 2023.

name: Concorde Hotel Singapore
description: Concorde Hotel Singapore is a hotel wedding venue located at 100 Orchard Road, offering both wedding lunch and dinner packages for 2026 and 2027. The venue provides personalised 8-course Chinese banquet menus, exquisite wedding decorations, bridal suite accommodation, and comprehensive AV equipment. Packages include complimentary food tasting, free flow soft drinks, champagne, beer, wine, wedding cake, floral decorations, red carpet march-in with dry ice misty effect, and more.

name: Conrad Singapore Marina Bay
description: An award-winning luxury hotel rising high above Marina Bay with panoramic views of the Singapore skyline. Conrad Singapore Marina Bay offers sophisticated wedding venues, unparalleled service, and exquisite cuisine. The dedicated team of wedding professionals focuses on personal preferences, meticulously crafting every detail to transform dream weddings into lasting memories. The hotel features over 3,400 pieces of Asian contemporary art, 512 guestrooms and suites, and is located near iconic landmarks such as Esplanade, Merlion Park, Suntec Convention Center, and the Singapore Flyer.

name: Conrad Singapore Orchard
description: Conrad Singapore Orchard offers elegant wedding experiences described as a poetic ode to your love story. The hotel features stylish venues, unmatched service, and exquisite catering. Wedding professionals exclusively tailor every detail to reflect each couple's distinctive style and personality. The hotel offers multiple wedding venues including the grand Royal Pavilion Ballroom, Tanglin Room, Nassim Room, Paterson Room, and the intimate Cuscaden Room. Catering options include Chinese cuisine prepared by the one Michelin-starred Summer Palace restaurant and authentic Italian cuisine by the award-winning Basilico restaurant. The hotel also supports pet-friendly nuptials and offers curated wedding partners including floral designers, decorators, bridal couturiers, and photographers.

name: Copthorne King's Hotel Singapore
description: Copthorne King's Hotel Singapore offers elegant wedding packages for 2025 & 2026, featuring the award-winning Tien Court Teochew Restaurant helmed by Master Chef Lui Wing Keung. The hotel offers three themed wedding experiences: Azure (tranquil sky and sea hues), Terrestrial (earthy nature tones), and Scarlett (romantic and sophisticated). The Bridal Suite features a separate living room, dining area, bedroom, and two private balconies. Tien Court has received the Tatler Dining Award 2024 and HoneyCombers Editor's Choice 2024.

name: Crowne Plaza Changi Airport
description: Crowne Plaza Changi Airport is voted the World's Best Airport Hotel by Skytrax for ten consecutive years. It offers contemporary venues for weddings, including the rainforest-themed Chengal Ballroom with six-metre ceiling height and 367 square metres of floor space ideal for up to 280 guests, and the intimate Camellia Room echoing the serenity of Changi Beach for up to 120 guests. The hotel offers beautiful spaces and bespoke service for wedding celebrations with Chinese and Western menu options.

name: Dusit Thani Laguna Singapore
description: From an intimate celebration to a lavish affair, Dusit Thani Laguna Singapore offers an exceptional setting where Thai-inspired graciousness meets modern elegance. With over 4,000 sqm of versatile indoor and outdoor spaces, stunning venues framed by lush greenery and views of two 18-hole Championship Golf Courses. Every detail is thoughtfully curated to create a celebration that is uniquely yours. Selected days offer the rare opportunity for pre-wedding and wedding shoots on the 18-hole Championship Golf Courses amidst breathtaking scenery.

name: Empress At Asian Civilisations Museum
address: 1 Empress Place, #01-03, Asian Civilisations Museum, Singapore 179555
description: Empress at the Asian Civilisations Museum is a venue that beautifully combines historical significance with modern elegance. Located at 1 Empress Place, this stunning venue offers the perfect setting for special occasions, with the captivating Singapore River as backdrop. Empress offers a blend of traditional cuisine, warm hospitality, and a lively atmosphere with indoor and alfresco seating options by the waterfront. The picturesque waterfront view adds a touch of romance and sophistication to any celebration.

name: Equarius Hotel / Ocean Gallery
description: Equarius Hotel at Resorts World Sentosa is a world-class wedding venue set in a lush tropical oasis. It offers elegant ballrooms with sprawling balconies, and a range of wedding packages for intimate solemnizations, whimsical photoshoots, or glamorous galas. The venue features the Equarius Ballroom and Saffron Room for wedding receptions, as well as the Equarius Lawn for outdoor solemnizations. Part of a world-class integrated resort featuring attractions including Universal Studios Singapore, Singapore Oceanarium, and Adventure Cove Waterpark.

name: Eternal Garden Restaurant 永福楼
description: A wedding venue offering the Eternal Garden Wedding Package with hotel-style banquet seating, cocktail reception party, wedding march and first course presentation with special effects including laser and disco lighting, smoke and music effects, big slim and high resolution LED screens, and a huge stage. Includes multi-tier dummy wedding cake, champagne fountain, and various complimentary items.

name: Fairmont Singapore And Swissôtel The Stamford
description: Fairmont Singapore offers a selection of newly renovated venues exuding timeless elegance with sweeping views on spacious grounds. From intimate celebrations in the Atrium Ballroom to extravagant ceremonies in the Fairmont Ballroom accommodating up to 1,400 people, or sky-high romance at SKAI Suites on Level 69 with unparalleled views of the Singapore skyline. Each venue sets the perfect stage for weddings with crystal chandeliers, city lights, and a dedicated team of experienced Romance specialists.

name: Fico
address: 1300 East Coast Parkway, Carpark F2, Singapore 468964
description: Nestled in East Coast Park's picturesque bougainvillaea garden, Fico brings a little Italian free spirit to wedding receptions or solemnisations. A beachfront escape framed by ocean views and blooming bougainvilleas, inspired by the stunning white masserias of Puglia, Chef Mirko's hometown. Spaces come to life with pieces crafted by Singaporean and Puglian artisans alike. Indoors, outdoors, or a mix of both. Cuisine is guided by Cucina Povera, a waste-not want-not approach using simple, humble ingredients transformed into sharing dishes. Produce sourced directly from Puglia — a first in Singapore.

name: Flutes
description: Ranked #7 in the Top 25 Restaurants, Flutes Restaurant at Guoco Midtown House is a romantic wedding venue offering exclusive use of the restaurant for solemnization and dining celebrations. The venue features long table setups, projectors and screens, and a terrace area for solemnization ceremonies. It offers both lunch and dinner wedding packages for up to 86 guests.

name: Four Points By Sheraton Singapore, Riverview
description: A wedding venue located by the river in Singapore, offering both Enchanted and Intimate wedding packages with curated Chinese menus, elegant décor themes, and riverside solemnisation settings. The venue features ballroom spaces for banquets and outdoor areas for solemnisation ceremonies with scenic river views.

name: Four Seasons Hotel Singapore
description: Four Seasons Hotel Singapore offers elegant wedding celebrations across multiple venues including the Four Seasons Ballroom, Crescent Ballroom, Windows East, and Windows West. The hotel features award-winning Executive Chinese Chef Alan Chan from the renowned Cantonese restaurant Jiang-Nan Chun, who crafts specially curated individually plated menus for weddings. The hotel offers both intimate weddings and larger ballroom celebrations with comprehensive packages including food, beverages, floral arrangements, wedding favours, and hotel stays.

name: Furama City Centre
address: Furama RiverFront: 405 Havelock Road, Singapore 169633 | Furama City Centre: 60 Eu Tong Sen Street, Singapore 059804
description: Furama Singapore operates two hotel properties — Furama RiverFront and Furama City Centre — offering wedding banquet packages under the 'A Summer's Dream 2026/2027' theme. Both hotels provide multiple ballroom options with varying capacities, comprehensive wedding packages including 8-course Chinese menus, free-flow beverages, full ballroom decorations, and complimentary honeymoon suite stays. Outdoor solemnisation is available by the pool outside the Mercury Ballroom at Furama RiverFront.

name: Furama RiverFront Singapore
description: Experience a vibrant and tranquil wedding celebration at Furama RiverFront, Singapore, where modern elegance meets the lush serenity of a tropical forest. Nestled between the central business district and the heritage charm of Tiong Bahru, this award-winning venue features stunning pillarless ballrooms with floor-to-ceiling windows that look out onto a cascading waterfall and verdant greenery. Whether you are planning a grand banquet or a romantic poolside solemnization, Furama RiverFront promises a seamless blend of versatile settings and exquisite culinary craftsmanship, ensuring an enchanting and unforgettable backdrop for your walk down the aisle.

name: Gardens By The Bay
description: Gardens by the Bay is a nature park and event venue in Singapore offering indoor event spaces including Flower Field Hall and Waterview Room. The venue provides rental services for weddings and events, with contracted timing from 0800-2359hrs. GB only provides venue rental services and requires hirers to work with appointed F&B caterers from their panel of 22 caterers. The venue does not provide F&B packages or allow external caterers. Basic AV equipment is included with venue rental. The venue holds the Singapore MICE Sustainability Certification - GOLD.

name: Genting Hotel Jurong
description: Genting Hotel Jurong is a wedding venue located in Singapore's Jurong Lake District, now part of Marriott Bonvoy. The hotel features the grand Genting Ballroom which can seat up to 330 guests and can be partitioned for intimate celebrations. Adjoining function rooms serve as ideal venues for tea ceremonies. The venue offers a range of wedding packages including weekday and weekend options, solemnisation packages, and various culinary choices.

name: Goodwood Park Hotel
description: An iconic heritage building set amidst lush landscaped gardens, Goodwood Park Hotel brings a touch of old-world romance and glamour to weddings. The hotel offers a range of elegant venues including romantic solemnisation ceremonies by beautiful pools, intimate celebrations at the Tudor Ballroom, and lavish affairs at the grand Windsor Ballroom. The hotel features colonial architecture and a dedicated team of experienced catering professionals.

name: Grand Copthorne Waterfront Hotel Singapore
description: An urban oasis by the river, where unparalleled hospitality meets a perfect harmony of eco-conscious design and luxury. Strategically located by the historic Singapore River, the hotel offers riverside elegance, plush rooms, and exquisite wedding venues. Guests can enhance their experience by arriving in a private chartered boat. The hotel offers multiple ballrooms for weddings, a romantic Promenade by the river for solemnisation, and a Bridal Suite for pre-wedding preparations and post-wedding relaxation.

name: Grand Hyatt Singapore
description: Grand Hyatt Singapore offers stunning wedding venues from grand ballrooms to intimate spaces, with tailored packages for contemporary and ethnic celebrations. The hotel features striking venues providing flexibility for any style of celebration, whether an intimate gathering for 50 or a lavish celebration for a larger guest list. Wedding packages include themed stationery designed by Grace Ciao (Forbes 30 Under 30 Asia honoree), fresh floral arrangements, hotel stays, dining credits, and exceptional Chinese cuisine crafted by seasoned chefs.

name: Grand Park City Hall
description: Grand Park City Hall is an architectural landmark hotel located in the heart of City Hall, Singapore. It offers wedding and solemnisation packages at its Rooftop Sky Garden and Tablescape Restaurant, allowing couples to create lasting memories and exchange vows in a stunning setting. The venue features multiple event spaces including a rooftop area with panoramic views, and various suite options for the bridal party.

name: Haus217
description: HAUS217 is a fresh venue that embodies the essence of Wabi Sabi, a Japanese lifestyle philosophy that highlights the charm and beauty in imperfection. Located in a 60-year-old shophouse, it beautifully blends timeless charm with modern elegance. The space features scrupulous cement plastered walls, meticulously crafted stained wood accents, 7 double-door textured windows, and sweeping arched passageways. This modern minimalist aesthetic provides a blank canvas for customised weddings. The venue is intimate and cosy, perfect for weddings of up to 80 pax, and features multiple rigging points across the ceiling for versatile styling.

name: Hilton Singapore Orchard
description: A landmark hotel in the heart of Orchard Road offering elegantly designed wedding venues including the Grand Ballroom with statement chandeliers and immersive LED walls, the four-tiered amphitheater-style Imperial Ballroom, The Manor with seven interconnected residential-style spaces, Osteria Mozza (Michelin-starred), and Estate restaurant. Every wedding is crafted by a dedicated team of wedding architects with thoughtful planning and iconic hospitality.

packages.package_name: Eight-Course Chinese Dinner Menu - Menu A
Eight-Course Chinese Dinner Menu - Saturday (Imperial Ballroom)

name: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Singapore Novena
description: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Singapore Novena is the smart choice for savvy business and leisure travellers, offering a relaxed, affordable and hassle-free stay. Located in the Balestier district of Singapore and home to many historical sites, from colonial-style villas to traditional shophouses and temples. Only 5-minute drive to Novena Square and Velocity, close to Mount Elizabeth and Tan Tock Seng Hospitals and 26-minute drive to Singapore Changi International Airport. The Express Café & Bar, an integrated lobby and Food & Beverage experience, is the first of its kind in the region.

name: Holiday Inn Singapore Orchard City Centre
description: Holiday Inn Singapore Orchard City Centre offers uniquely designed function spaces and ballrooms for wedding celebrations. The hotel provides comprehensive wedding packages including the Stay Intimate and Stay Blissful packages, with options for both intimate gatherings and larger celebrations. Located at 11 Cavenagh Road, the hotel is owned by Harilela Hotels (S) Pte Ltd and managed by IHG® Hotels & Resorts.

name: Il Giardino @ The Garage
description: The Garage is a wedding venue offering exclusive wedding celebrations with award-winning culinary team. Hosts wedding showcases and offers customised wedding packages for lunch and dinner events. Features outdoor terrace and indoor dining areas.

name: Jen Singapore Tanglin By Shangri-la
description: JEN Singapore Tanglin by Shangri-La is a hotel wedding venue located at 1A Cuscaden Road, Singapore. It offers multiple ballrooms for weddings including The Gallery, Temasek Ballroom, and Malacca Penang Ballroom. The venue features pillar-less ballrooms with natural daylight, and is conveniently located opposite Orchard Boulevard MRT Station (Thomson East Coast Line – TE13). The hotel offers Classic Collection and Intimate Moments wedding packages with Chinese banquet menus.

name: Jw Marriott Hotel Singapore South Beach
description: Set in a gazetted heritage building, the Grand Ballroom is a stylish venue that combines the old world charm of the 1930s with state-of-the-art audio-visual system and a dramatic end-to-end, floor-to-ceiling LED backdrop. The exquisite 'Forest of Lights' installation creates customisable lighting effects to set the right atmosphere and theme tailored to your wedding. Heritage, design and legendary service come together to create distinct weddings of sophisticated luxury. The venue features two signature restaurants, a gin bar and The NCO Club featuring four eclectic concepts, as well as a signature Spa by JW.

name: Lawry's The Prime Rib Singapore
description: Lawry's The Prime Rib Singapore is an iconic fine dining restaurant located at Mandarin Gallery on Orchard Road, celebrating special occasions since 1938. Founded by Mr. Lawrence Frank and Mr. Walter Van de Kamp in Beverly Hills, the restaurant is renowned for its Signature Roasted USDA Prime Rib of Beef, aged up to 21 days, slowly roasted on beds of rock salt and expertly carved tableside from iconic 'Silver Carts'. The restaurant features the Famous Original Spinning Bowl Salad and freshly baked Yorkshire Pudding. Overlooking Orchard Road through 4-metre high floor-to-ceiling windows, Lawry's offers an elegant setting for weddings, corporate events, birthdays, solemnisations, baby showers, product launches, seminars, and more. The venue provides bespoke menus, impeccable service, and world-class hospitality.

rooms.room_name: Main Dining Hall with Private Dining Rooms

name: Little Island Brewing Co @ Changi Village
address: Block 6 Changi Village #01-01, Singapore 509907 / 43 Malan Road #01-01, Singapore 109443 / 26 Beach Road #B1-16 South Beach Avenue, Singapore 189768
description: Little Island Brewing Co. (LIBC) is a craft brewery and event venue with three locations in Singapore: Changi Village, Gillman Barracks, and South Beach. They offer wedding packages featuring delicious food, expertly brewed craft beers, signature drinks, live music, and a fun vibrant atmosphere. They welcome pets and offer unconventional, whimsical celebrations. Their wedding mascot is the Oriental Pied Hornbill, symbolizing marital bliss and fidelity.

name: M Hotel Singapore City Centre
description: M Hotel Singapore City Centre offers bespoke wedding experiences for both intimate solemnisations and grand banquet weddings. Located in the heart of Singapore, the hotel features state-of-the-art technology, exquisite culinary creations, dedicated services, and elegantly designed ballrooms. The hotel offers two dedicated wedding venues: the Banquet Suite on Level 10 and the Anson Room on Level 2, each providing a magnificent setting for wedding celebrations.

name: Mandai Rainforest Resort By Banyan Tree
description: A lush, tropical paradise wedding venue set within the Mandai Wildlife Reserve in Singapore. Surrounded by sweeping greenery and serene lake views, the resort offers an enchanting backdrop for weddings. Features include a pillarless ballroom, rooftop deck solemnisation venue, and exclusive access to Singapore Zoo, Rainforest Wild Asia and Bird Paradise for photography sessions.

name: Mandai Wildlife Reserve
description: Wild Weddings at Mandai Wildlife Reserve offers unique wedding experiences amidst lush greenery and wildlife. Venues include Forest Lodge at Singapore Zoo (up to 220 pax, lunch or dinner), Crimson Restaurant at Bird Paradise (up to 80 pax, lunch), Tipi Tent at Night Safari (up to 40 pax, dinner), and The Oculus at Rainforest Wild ASIA (up to 30 pax, solemnisation). From intimate solemnisations to grand banquets, each venue offers a truly unique wildlife backdrop with bespoke menus and optional floral styling.

rooms.room_name: The Oculus at Rainforest Wild ASIA

name: Mandarin Oriental Singapore
description: Mandarin Oriental, Singapore offers exceptional wedding celebrations amidst a refreshed space and design, encapsulating the essence of an Exceptionally Singapore experience. The venue features The Oriental Ballroom, Atrium Suites, and Garden Suite for wedding receptions, offering a 6-Course Individually-plated Chinese Gastronomy selection and signature service to curate memories that will last a lifetime.

packages.package_name: 6-Course Chinese Set Dinner - The Oriental Ballroom

name: Marina Bay Sands Singapore
description: Marina Bay Sands is a luxury hotel and integrated resort in Singapore offering a range of wedding packages for various guest sizes. They offer four wedding packages: Enchanting Matrimony (up to 100 guests, $28,888), Romantic Matrimony (50-100 guests), Blissful Matrimony (101-150 guests), Joyous Celebrations (151-250 guests), and Grand Celebrations (251+ guests). All packages include specially curated wedding menus, hotel stays, decorations, and technical systems. The venue features ballrooms, bridal changing rooms, and various event spaces including an outdoor solemnization area.

name: Mercure Singapore Bugis
description: Nestled in the vibrant Bugis, Mercure Singapore Bugis offers the Queen Ballroom and enchanting Courtyard for weddings and solemnisations. The pillarless ballroom features celestial lighting and soaring ceilings. The outdoor Courtyard provides a serene garden sanctuary for ROM ceremonies. The venue can accommodate from 30 to 120 persons across 3 to 12 tables, offering both intimate and grand wedding celebrations.

name: Mercure Singapore On Stevens
description: Novotel Singapore on Stevens is a hotel wedding venue nestled along the gateway to Orchard Road, offering a unique dual-hotel setting with Mercure Singapore on Stevens, surrounded by lush greenery. Designed as a garden oasis on the fringe of the city, the venue offers a harmonious blend of tranquillity and convenience. It features elegant pillarless ballrooms, romantic al-fresco lawns, and naturally lit function rooms suitable for weddings of all styles and sizes. The venue offers the Nova wedding package and Twilight Weddings brand, and has won the Brides Choice Preferred Banquet Venues Winner 2025 award.

name: Mett Singapore
description: Set within the iconic grounds of Fort Canning Park, METT Singapore is a beautifully restored colonial landmark with 84 elegant rooms. It offers heritage architecture, lush surroundings, and contemporary interiors as an exceptional backdrop for weddings. From intimate garden moments to grand ballroom receptions, the venue provides curated wedding packages with refined dining, serene suites, and personalized service. The venue features the Grand Ballroom, Junior Ballroom, Garden Terrace, and Canning Terrace for various wedding configurations.

name: Min Jiang (dempsey)
description: Min Jiang at Dempsey is a Chinese restaurant wedding venue located at Dempsey Road, Singapore, operated under Goodwood Park Hotel. It offers elegant wedding packages with 7-course individual serving menus, available for both lunch and dinner events. The venue features a Main Dining Hall and an extended Dining Room, with legendary wood-fired Beijing Duck as a signature dish.

name: Mondrian Singapore Duxton
description: Mondrian Singapore Duxton is a boutique hotel located at Duxton Hill offering wedding packages. It features Bottega Di Carna, a modern Italian restaurant with floor-to-ceiling windows and natural light, the Mondrian Garden for outdoor solemnisations with lush greenery, water features, a secret garden walkway and arcs as a perfect backdrop, and the Shophouse Suite XL (128sqm) inspired by traditional Singaporean architecture for bridal suite use.

name: Monti At 1-pavilion
description: Monti is a wedding venue offering stunning event spaces with views of Marina Bay's fireworks display. The venue hosts wedding showcases and offers comprehensive wedding packages for lunch and dinner events on weekdays and weekends. Known for its innovative and award-winning culinary team, Monti provides a luxurious wedding experience with dedicated wedding planners, champagne fountains, floral centrepieces, and partnerships with brands like SonderbyCo and Petalo Cakery.

name: Mount Faber Peak
address: 109 Mount Faber Road, Mount Faber Peak, Singapore 099203
description: Romantic hilltop wedding venue at Mount Faber Peak, Singapore, offering stunning floor-to-ceiling views of the harbour, Sentosa, and the cable car line. Multiple venues available including The Ballroom, Angsana Glasshouse, Arbora @ Mount Faber Peak, and Dusk & The Mirabilis Bar. Features spectacular sunset views, alfresco dining options, and the iconic Bells of Happiness for solemnisation ceremonies.

packages.package_name: Ballroom Buffet / Modern European Set Menu

name: Novotel Singapore On Stevens
description: A celestial-themed wedding venue offering banquet packages for weddings and solemnisations. Features the 'Constellation' and 'Galactical' banquet packages with Chinese set menus, as well as the 'Starlit Vows' solemnisation package. Pets are welcome at solemnisation events. Also offers 'Tipsy Constellations' afterparty at L'Apéritif.

name: Oasia Hotel Downtown
description: Oasia by Far East Hospitality offers wedding celebrations at two properties: Oasia Hotel Downtown and Oasia Hotel Novena. Oasia Hotel Downtown features nature-inspired settings including a Sky Terrace and Retreat Room, offering the Enchanted Wedding Package. Oasia Hotel Novena features the Courtyard Room, Fountain Foyer, and outdoor spaces including a Garden Gazebo, offering the Classical Wedding Package. Both hotels provide exquisite floral themed arrangements, champagne towers, and various wedding themes including Spring Blush, Rustic Chic, Tropical Summer, and Vintage Glamour.

name: Oasia Resort Sentosa
description: 2026 Wedding Package offered by Far East Hospitality at three Sentosa properties: Oasia Resort Sentosa, The Outpost Hotel Sentosa, and Village Hotel Sentosa. Three wedding venues available: Revelry Hall, The Aloes, and The Commune. Packages include comprehensive inclusions such as menu tasting, free flow drinks, champagne, wedding cake, LCD projector, carpark coupons, Sentosa Island admission, hotel stay, and spa treatments. Rates applicable for weddings held by 31 December 2026.

name: One Farrer Hotel
description: One Farrer Hotel is a SGClean certified hotel located beside/above Farrer Park MRT Station. It features a pillarless Grand Ballroom of 698sqm with high ceilings (5.7m) adorned with modern chandeliers, twin 4.5m screens, and smart lighting solutions. The hotel also offers smaller function/meeting rooms (Napier, Read, and Spottiswoode) with floor-to-ceiling glass window panels offering spectacular city views. Recently refurbished Mint Suite bridal suite features anti-microbial gapless vinyl flooring, anti-viral wallcoverings, living area, powder room, bay windows, high-speed Wi-Fi, and intelligent mood lighting. The hotel is a member of Preferred Hotels & Resorts and is capable of hosting live, virtual, and hybrid events with streaming capabilities.

name: One°15 Marina Sentosa Cove
description: ONE°15 Marina Sentosa Cove Singapore offers two distinct wedding venues: the Constellation Ballroom and the Iconic Building. The Constellation Ballroom is a magnificent pillarless venue designed to host grand occasions, with an expansive foyer that transitions into breathtaking marina vistas, accommodating up to 360 guests. The Iconic Building features the stylish Bar Nebula and the sophisticated NOVA Room with a unique ship's hull design, floor-to-ceiling glass windows offering panoramic views of the marina and lush surroundings, accommodating up to 120 guests. Both venues offer Classic, Deluxe, and Premium wedding packages for 2026.

name: Orchard Hotel Singapore
description: Host your wedding amidst the perfect setting at the breathtaking largest pillarless ballroom right at the heart of the city, holding up to a hundred tables. Dedicated wedding consultants will weave together every detail, ensuring a seamless celebration of love. Offers Chinese, Malay, and Indian wedding packages with various dining styles including family set menus and buffets.

name: Orchid Country Club
description: Orchid Country Club is a premier country club in Singapore offering elegant wedding banquet facilities including the Grand Ballroom, Sapphire Suite, and Emerald Suite. The club features award-winning 27-hole golf courses, 160-bay driving range, Orchid Lodge with 75 hotel rooms, pillar-less Grand Ballroom for up to 1,500 pax, 8 F&B outlets, gymnasium, lifestyle studio, tennis courts, 3 swimming pools, jackpot & mahjong rooms, karaoke rooms, and a 36-lane bowling alley. Wedding packages include both weekday/weekend lunch and dinner options with Chinese menus catered by Ban Heng and Halal/Indian menus catered by Royal Palm.

name: Orchid Hotel Singapore
address: 1 Tras Link, Orchid Hotel, Level 3, Singapore 078867
description: Ya Ge is a Chinese restaurant located at Orchid Hotel (Level 3) in Singapore, offering solemnisation and wedding packages in a garden setting. The venue provides romantic garden settings for solemnisations and lush indoor dining experiences with exquisite Chinese cuisine. They offer multiple wedding and solemnisation packages ranging from intimate gatherings to full wedding banquets, featuring set menus with Chinese cuisine, complimentary house wine, and various add-on services.

name: Pan Pacific Singapore
description: Pan Pacific Singapore is a GSTC-certified luxury hotel offering elegant wedding venues including the Pacific Ballroom, Ocean Ballroom, Keyaki Japanese Restaurant, Hai Tien Lo Chinese Restaurant, and Pool Side Pavilion. The hotel provides comprehensive wedding packages under the 'Sincerely Yours Celebrations' brand, featuring bespoke menus curated by the award-winning Hai Tien Lo restaurant team, stunning LED walls, artisanal floral themes, and dedicated wedding specialists to guide couples through every step of their celebration.

name: Paradox Singapore
description: Paradox Singapore features a newly reimagined Merchant Court Ballroom located on the lobby level, blending architectural grandeur with contemporary elegance. With soaring 5.5-metre ceilings and expansive floor-to-ceiling windows, the space is bathed in natural daylight and styled for unforgettable moments. An impressive 21-metre wall-to-wall LED screen transforms wedding visuals into cinematic splendour. The hotel offers exquisite Cantonese cuisine crafted by an award-winning culinary team, and focuses exclusively on one wedding couple per meal period. Conveniently located with sheltered access to Clarke Quay MRT station.

name: Parkroyal Collection Marina Bay Singapore
description: A luxurious hotel venue in Marina Bay, Singapore, offering artfully designed ballrooms with nature-inspired themes and exquisite culinary creations. The venue features two main ballrooms - the Garden Ballroom on Level 1 and the Atrium Ballroom on Level 5 - along with smaller function rooms for intimate gatherings. The hotel is certified by the Global Sustainable Tourism Council (GSTC), Green Globe, and Singapore's Building and Construction Authority (BCA) Green Mark Super Low Energy (SLE).

name: Parkroyal Collection Pickering
description: PARKROYAL COLLECTION Pickering is a wedding venue in Singapore featuring function venues with 5.6-meter-high ceilings offering exquisite cuisine crafted by their chef. The hotel offers two ballrooms - the William Pickering Ballroom and the Alexander Room - for wedding banquets, as well as an Outdoor Terrace for solemnisation ceremonies. The venue provides comprehensive wedding packages including Chinese set menus, beverages, floral arrangements, wedding cake, champagne fountain, bridal suite stays, and various other inclusions. The hotel is wheelchair accessible and part of the Pan Pacific Hotels Group.

name: Parkroyal On Beach Road
description: PARKROYAL on Beach Road is a hotel wedding venue in Singapore featuring an immersive LED display wall, multiple ballrooms including the Sky Ballroom and Grand Ballroom, with parking conveniently located beneath the Ballroom. The venue offers three stunning new wedding themes, 8-course Cantonese menus by Master Chef Chong, and a range of pampering treats for couples. The hotel is GSTC-certified.

name: Peach Garden @ Ocbc Centre
description: Peach Garden Chinese Restaurant offers wedding banquet services across multiple venues in Singapore, serving delectable Cantonese food with excellent services. Venues include OCBC Centre (Level 33, Elevated Elegance), The Heeren (Modern Sophistication, heart of Orchard), The Metropolis (Sunlit Simplicity, floor-to-ceiling glass panels), and Thomson Plaza (Enchanting Bliss). Suitable for both intimate affairs and luxurious weddings.

name: Peach Garden @ The Heeren
description: Peach Garden Chinese Restaurant offers wedding banquet services across multiple venues in Singapore, serving delectable Cantonese food with excellent service. Venues include OCBC Centre (Level 33, Elevated Elegance), The Heeren (Modern Sophistication, nestled in the heart of Orchard), The Metropolis (Sunlit Simplicity, with floor-to-ceiling glass panels), and Thomson Plaza (Enchanting Bliss). Each venue is curated for both intimate affairs and luxurious weddings.

name: Peach Garden @ The Metropolis
description: Peach Garden Chinese Restaurant offers wedding banquet venues across multiple locations in Singapore, serving delectable Cantonese food with excellent service. Their curated venues and menus are fitting for both intimate affairs and luxurious weddings, featuring 8-course Chinese menus and premium perks.

name: Peach Garden @ Thomson Plaza
description: Peach Garden Chinese Restaurant offers wedding banquet venues across multiple locations in Singapore, serving delectable Cantonese food with excellent services. Their curated venues and menus are fitting for both intimate affairs and luxurious weddings, featuring 8-course Chinese menus and premium perks.

name: Pullman Singapore Hill Street
description: A five-star hotel nestled in the heart of Singapore's cultural district, combining modern luxury with historical charm. Pullman Singapore Hill Street blends the timeless tradition of luxury train travel with modern elegance, offering stunning venues for weddings ranging from intimate ceremonies to grand celebrations. The hotel features breathtaking views of Marina Bay, lush greenery, and picturesque photography locations including a scenic rooftop and the Oculus Glasshouse.

packages.package_name: Oculus Western/Fusion Buffet or 4-Course Set Menu

name: Pullman Singapore Orchard
description: Located in the heart of Orchard Road at Pullman Singapore Orchard, The Gallery is a versatile venue for social celebrations and wedding dinners. Featuring state-of-the-art LED screens, the space can be personalised with your own memories and themes. The venue offers Modern Asian, Western, and Buffet dining options, with a welcome reception area (Arrival Foyer and Gallery Foyer) and the main Gallery function room. A separate Saffron room is available for solemnisation ceremonies.

name: Qt Singapore
description: QT Singapore is a boutique luxury hotel offering unique wedding experiences. The hotel boasts an eclectic collection of spaces including light-filled atriums, stately lobbies, poolside oases, and a stunning rooftop with city skyline views. The venue offers bespoke wedding packages from proposal to honeymoon, with tailored menus, premium beverages, and dedicated event planning. Known for its bold design aesthetic, the hotel features Cygnet Restaurant with an open kitchen, a sophisticated bar, and multiple private dining spaces.

name: Raffles Marina
description: Raffles Marina is a premier waterfront venue located in the West of Singapore, offering an idyllic setting framed by breathtaking sunsets and a serene waterfront. It is a member of the YTL Cement Group and provides elegant wedding banquet options in the Compass Ballroom as well as intimate outdoor lawn celebrations. The venue offers dedicated wedding consultants committed to bringing dream weddings to life, from meticulous planning to flawless execution.

name: Raffles Sentosa Singapore
description: An oasis immersed in nature and well-being, Raffles Sentosa Singapore overlooks the majestic Singapore Strait. It is an Eden nestled at the edge of Sentosa island, a tropical sanctuary connected by a brief span to the vibrant and cosmopolitan Singapore metropolis. The retreat is a celebration of life inviting guests to immerse themselves in a secluded world where the five senses converge to create a delightful journey of well-being and shared memories. The venue offers luxury wedding packages for 2026 and 2027, featuring the Garden Room and Raffles Ballroom, along with outdoor and pool solemnization options.

name: Raffles Singapore
description: Raffles Hotel Singapore is a legendary National Monument offering extraordinary settings for weddings and romantic celebrations. The hotel features distinctive colonial architecture with elegant ambience, world-class gourmet experiences, and legendary Raffles service. Venues span gorgeous outdoor spaces, sunlit indoor foyers, and inviting restaurants. The hotel offers a blend of tradition and modernity with stunning chandeliers, ornate embellishments, and spectacular craftsmanship. A dedicated team of wedding specialists orchestrates flawless and memorable events.

name: Red Dot Brewhouse
description: RedDot BrewHouse is a lush garden venue tucked away from the busy city, seated atop Dempsey Hill. It is a dog-friendly restaurant offering a relaxed chill-out ambience with a sheltered outdoor garden, lower and upper indoor decks. The venue is a Green Venue and SG Clean certified. It is home to Singapore's first female brewmaster and has won Best Local Brew and Best IPA Beer at Beerfest Asia 2016, as well as World Beer Awards World's Best Style Winner and Country Winner.

name: Rendezvous Hotel Singapore At Bras Basah
description: Situated in the vibrant Arts and Heritage district along Bras Basah Road, Rendezvous Hotel Singapore blends historic architecture with contemporary interior - the perfect place for a classic yet modern celebration. The hotel offers the Timeless Rendezvous 2026 wedding package with customisable 8-course menus, exclusive floral themes, and a range of complimentary perks. The venue features the Symphony Ballroom as its primary wedding space, with additional rooms including Canvas I, Canvas II, Origami Room, and Drawing Room.

name: Royal Plaza On Scotts
description: Royal Plaza on Scotts offers over 4,000 sqft of exquisite wedding spaces with jaw-dropping floor-to-ceiling windows and ample natural light. The venue can be personalised for any kind of event, whether lavish or intimate in scale, stylish, sophisticated and refined with playful pops of colours. Features customised mouthwatering menus by Carousel restaurant, Halal-certified kitchens, and dedicated wedding specialists to assist with every detail.

name: Saf Yacht Club
description: SAF Yacht Club (SAFYC) is a members' club established since 1967, located at Admiralty Road West, Singapore. The club offers event spaces including the Lazarus Ballroom and Poolside Lounge, suitable for weddings and other events. Multiple catering vendors are available offering International, Malay, and Indian buffet options.

name: Safra Mount Faber Club
description: A wedding venue offering multiple Chinese banquet menu packages for 10 pax, ranging from SGD$1168 to SGD$1788 NETT. Menus feature traditional Chinese wedding dishes including shark's fin soup, roasted crispy chicken, braised abalone, and various seafood options.

name: Seletar Country Club
description: Seletar Country Club is a award-winning banquet venue (Brides Editor's Choice Preferred Banquet Venues Winner 2024) offering wedding solemnization, lunch, and dinner packages for 2025/2026. The club features beautiful event spaces including the Fountain Terrace for ROM ceremonies, a golf course available for photoshoots, and modern facilities including built-in screens, projectors, and sound systems. The venue provides complimentary shuttle bus service to/from Khatib MRT and complimentary self-parking for all guests.

name: Serangoon Gardens Country Club
description: Serangoon Gardens Country Club (SGCC) offers a perfect venue for weddings and events, featuring multiple function rooms and ballrooms. The venue offers Chinese Wedding Dinner Packages for 2025/2026, with 8-course Chinese cuisine, complimentary beverages, decorations, and a range of amenities for banquets, meetings, and seminars.

name: Shangri-la Rasa Sentosa
description: Begin your forever at Singapore's only beachfront resort. Whether you dream of a golden-hour ceremony by the water's edge or an elegant celebration in a sunlit ballroom with sweeping sea views, our tranquil seaside setting and dedicated team will help you craft a wedding that is as meaningful as it is beautiful.

name: Shangri-la Singapore
description: Shangri-La Singapore is a luxury hotel offering wedding celebrations across multiple event spaces including the Azalea Room, Banyan Deck, Dutch Pavilion, Tower Ballroom, Island Ballroom, and The Orchid. The Azalea Room is located at the mezzanine floor of the hotel lobby with a ceiling height of 2.2m and no natural daylight. Banyan Deck is an outdoor venue available for solemnisation. The hotel offers both Chinese and Western set menus, buffet options, and can cater to various dietary requirements.

name: Sheraton Towers Singapore
description: Sheraton Towers Singapore is a hotel offering wedding packages including the Bespoke, Splendour, and Lavish packages, as well as a Solemnisation Package. The venue features the award-winning Li Bai Cantonese Restaurant, multiple ballroom options, a Topaz Room, a Waterfall Pavilion for solemnisation, and a Bridal Suite. Packages are available for January to December 2026/2027 and include Chinese set menus, buffet options, decorations, and various privileges.

name: Shisen Hanten By Chen Kentaro
address: Hilton Singapore Orchard, 333 Orchard Road, Level 35, Singapore 238867
description: Shisen Hanten by Chen Kentaro is Singapore's sole specialist and MICHELIN-starred restaurant in Chūka Szechwan Ryori, a distinctive style of Japanese-Szechwan cuisine. Built on three generations of gastronomic excellence, this restaurant seamlessly connects the culinary traditions of China, Japan, and Singapore. The restaurant was awarded two Michelin stars in 2016 and has retained one Michelin star in both 2023 and 2024. It is also featured in La Liste's top 1000 restaurants in the world for 2025. The space features an air of refined opulence blending Japanese and Chinese elements with soft natural light, synchronized tableside service, and an elegant glass-enclosed wine cellar showcasing up to 1,740 bottles.

rooms.room_name: Exclusive Venue (Main Hall and Private Rooms)

name: Singapore Chinese Cultural Centre
description: The Singapore Chinese Cultural Centre (SCCC) aims to nurture and promote Singapore Chinese culture, and to foster mutual understanding among all ethnic communities of our multi-cultural heritage. Opened by Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong on 19 May 2017, SCCC strives to become a hub for high-quality performances, exhibitions and cultural activities, and a lively and interactive platform for all ethnic communities to gather and interact with one another. The Centre aspires to be a community institution for everyone to participate in and appreciate Singapore Chinese culture, and to establish itself as a cultural landmark locally as well as in the region.

name: Singapore Island Country Club (sicc) (bukit Location)
description: Singapore Island Country Club is a prestigious country club offering wedding and event venues across two locations (Island and Bukit). The club provides comprehensive banquet services including multiple menu options, professional stage and sound systems, and a range of add-on services through trusted partner agencies. Venues include ballrooms and The Habitat, catering to weddings, solemnizations, corporate events, and more.

name: Singapore Island Country Club (sicc) (island Location)
description: The Singapore Island Country Club (SICC) is a prestigious private country club offering wedding and banquet facilities at two locations - Island Location and Bukit Location. The club offers a range of menu packages including Asian & International Buffet, Chinese Set Menu, Western Set Menu, and a Vegetarian Set Menu. Inclusive amenities include built-in full length projectors & screens, professional stage & sound system setup, standard mood lightings, customised table settings, unlimited serving of soft drinks and/or tea throughout the event, and complimentary car parking for guests at open air carparks E & F. Additional services available through trusted partner agencies include event décor, floral arch, photography, videography, entertainment, and karaoke system rental.

name: Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel
description: Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel offers grand wedding packages in their Grand Ballroom, featuring award-winning Cantonese cuisine prepared by Wan Hao Chinese Restaurant. The venue offers multiple wedding packages including lunch and dinner options, with 8-course Chinese wedding banquets and a premium 6-course individually plated Chinese wedding option. Packages include complimentary bridal room stays, wedding planning assistance, and Marriott Bonvoy loyalty rewards.

name: Singapore Swimming Club
description: Singapore Swimming Club is a premier family club located at Tanjong Rhu Road. The club offers wedding packages including Chinese Banquet, Western Set, and International/Bollywood Buffet options. The ballroom is set to undergo renovation mid-2026. The club provides exclusive venue usage, elegant dining setups, and various wedding privileges for special occasions.

name: Sky Garden Sentosa
address: 43 Siloso Beach Walk, #05-01, iFly Singapore, Singapore 099010
description: Located on the roof of iFly Singapore, Sky Garden Sentosa cleverly brings together a lush outdoor garden and an indoor air-conditioned hall, giving you the dream garden wedding you've always wanted, without compromising on the comfort of your guests. Luxuriate in the panoramic sea view and breathe in the tranquillity of nature with us, where you get to enjoy the best of both worlds. Transform your special occasion into an extravagant celebration basking in a mesmerizing sunset and spectacular fireworks.

name: Sofitel Singapore City Centre
description: Celebrate lavishly on your special day with your loved ones in the pillarless Wallich Ballroom and function space. The dedicated team of wedding specialists are committed to curating the most memorable wedding experience. Offers Maison Weddings packages including 6 Course Premium, 7 Course Chinese, and 8 Course Chinese menus. The Magnifique Wedding Menu features exquisite Chinese cuisine prepared by the Sofitel culinary team with extensive menu customization options.

name: Sofitel Singapore Sentosa
description: Sofitel Singapore Sentosa Resort & Spa is a luxury hotel wedding venue located on Sentosa Island. It offers two ballrooms (Saffron and Straits) for wedding banquets, an outdoor solemnisation garden, and comprehensive wedding packages including lunch, dinner, and solemnisation options. The venue caters to various dietary requirements and offers both buffet and sit-down dining styles.

name: Spring Court Chinese Restaurant Singapore
description: Spring Court is a traditional Singaporean Chinese cuisine restaurant established in 1929. Located at Upper Cross Street, Singapore, it offers wedding banquet packages with various privileges including free flow of Chinese tea, soft drinks, appetizers, draft beer, invitation cards, and no corkage charge for wine and hard liquor. The restaurant provides champagne pouring ceremony, wedding cake cutting ceremony, wedding decorations, bride and groom walk-in ceremony, bridal makeup room, and valet parking.

name: Test
description: Test Ade

name: The Alkaff Mansion
description: The Alkaff Mansion is a historic wedding venue offering elegant wedding celebrations with an award-winning culinary team. The venue features Level 2 for wedding celebrations, a foyer and outdoor pavilion for solemnization ceremonies, and a private bridal room. The venue hosts wedding showcases and offers curated packages for Saturday/Sunday lunches, Friday/Saturday dinners, and Sunday dinners with Spanish-inspired cuisine.

name: The Barracks Hotel Sentosa / The Outpost Hotel Sentosa
description: Wedding venues offered by Far East Hospitality at Oasia Resort Sentosa and The Barracks Hotel Sentosa. Multiple event spaces available including Revelry Hall, The Aloes, The Commune, and Barracks Lawn. Packages include dining, beverages, decorations, and complimentary perks for weddings held by 31 December 2026.

Sol & Dine at The Aloes (min 80 persons)

name: The Capitol Kempinski Hotel Singapore
description: The Capitol Kempinski Hotel Singapore is a historic luxury hotel offering elegant wedding venues. The hotel features multiple event spaces including The Atelier with hand-painted chinoiserie wallpaper, the grand and historic Capitol Theatre, and the highly exclusive Private Room for intimate gatherings. The hotel has been part of Kempinski - Hoteliers since 1897 and is a member of Global Hotel Alliance, Leading Hotels of the World, Virtuoso Hotels & Resorts, Serandipians by Traveller Made, and Fine Hotels + Resorts.

name: The Fullerton Hotel Singapore
description: The Straits Room at The Fullerton Hotel Singapore is a wedding venue accommodating between 100 and 140 persons. Located at 1 Fullerton Square, Singapore. Wedding packages are available for both lunch and dinner on Saturday, 02 January 2027. Note: there will be an increment of $10++ per person from the current package for weddings held during the first half of 2027. The kitchen is not halal-certified, but a no-pork no-lard menu can be arranged for Muslim guests.

name: The Masons Table
description: The Masons Table is a truly one-of-a-kind venue for weddings, solemnisations, and receptions of all sizes, situated just steps away from the Registry of Marriages (ROM) in Singapore. Located at 23A Coleman Street, it is a historic and exquisite venue by Victus Group. The venue features a Main Room and Bar Room, with full AV equipment, in-house catering, a full bar service, and extended services including florals, photography, live bands and DJs. The team has decades of combined experience in event planning.

name: The Ritz-carlton, Millenia Singapore
description: The Ritz-Carlton, Millenia Singapore is a luxury hotel offering multiple wedding celebration venues including the Grand Ballroom, Garden Pavilion, Junior Ballroom, and North Pavilion. The hotel has received numerous accolades including DestinAsian 2025 Readers' Choice Award (No. 3 in Best Singapore Hotels), Travel + Leisure World's Best Awards 2025 (No. 3 City Hotels in Singapore), and MICHELIN Guide Singapore 2025 (Summer Pavilion, One MICHELIN Star). Packages are valid until 31 March 2027.

name: The Riverhouse Singapore
description: Nestled in the heart of Clarke Quay, The Riverhouse stands as an iconic heritage wedding venue in Singapore, perfect for the visionary bride and groom. With its bold interior and soaring high ceilings, this historic landmark offers a one-of-a-kind setting, befitting the wedding of your dreams — an exceptional choice for a Chinese restaurant wedding in Singapore. The venue features Mimi, a swanky and chic modern Chinese restaurant on the 2nd level serving innovative Chinese fusion tapas, and Pulse on another level. The venue fuses intriguing flavours from Sichuan, Shanghai and Mongolia with contemporary cooking techniques and distinctive presentations.

name: The Robertson House By The Crest Collection
description: Nestled along Singapore's storied quayside, The Robertson House offers an enchanting backdrop for weddings and solemnizations. A heritage charm meets modern sophistication venue offering elegant receptions to intimate solemnizations, each wedding thoughtfully curated with Anglo-Asian cuisine inspired by their signature restaurant Entrepôt. The venue blends tradition and modern memories along Robertson Quay.

name: The Secret Haven
description: A beautiful heritage building designed for small to medium intimate occasions, featuring high ceilings, a centre skylight, and instagrammable architecture. The venue offers both outdoor greenery and cozy indoor comforts, with a pillarless hall boasting a 15m ceiling and a one-of-a-kind ceiling art installation. Located at 31 Mount Sophia, Singapore, the venue is available for weddings, solemnisations, and other events. Collaborates with Cafe Manna for catering and Flora Artisan for floral decorations.

name: The Singapore Edition
description: The Singapore EDITION is a luxury hotel located at 38 Cuscaden Road, Singapore, positioned as 'The New Generation of Luxury'. The hotel features a stunning lobby with gold oval ceiling feature, lush tropical greenery throughout public spaces, a Lobby Bar, and the signature restaurant FYSH at EDITION helmed by acclaimed Australian restaurateur Josh Niland. The hotel offers world-class wedding facilities including a 600 sqm pillarless Ballroom with crystal chandeliers, a Pre-Function Area with garden views, an outdoor Garden for solemnizations, and an intimate Boardroom. The venue is first in Southeast Asia to offer grand celebrations spanning across an impressive 340-seat Ballroom with idyllic views of an outdoor garden surrounded by luscious greenery. After-party options include Punch Room Singapore, Pink Room, and Wonder Room.

packages.package_name: Intimate - Chinese 6 Course or Western 4 Course (Premium)

name: The St. Regis Singapore
description: The St. Regis Singapore offers luxury wedding venues including the newly transformed pillarless John Jacob Ballroom spanning 7,638 square metres with two 9.6m by 5.29m LED walls, 10 intelligent lighting systems, and state-of-the-art sound system, as well as Caroline's Mansion for intimate wedding celebrations. From inspirational table set ups to live culinary showmanship, The St. Regis Singapore crafts exquisite celebrations.

name: The Standard Singapore
description: The Standard, Singapore is a unique hotel and event venue located at 12 Orange Grove Road. It offers multiple event spaces including KAYA at The Standard (a Japanese Izakaya restaurant), Café Standard (an American pop culture-inspired bistro), The Garden (an open-air outdoor space), and Suites. The venue is designed for weddings, private parties, corporate gatherings, team-building events, product launches, and celebrations. With a fresh, fun, and unmistakably Standard vibe, the venue offers flexible indoor and outdoor layouts, in-house sound systems, and curated menus.

name: Village Hotel Changi
description: Village Hotel Changi and Village Hotel Katong are wedding venues under Far East Hospitality offering Eternal Vows and Timeless Union wedding packages. They provide Chinese set menus, Western set menus, and buffet options for both lunch and dinner. The venues feature multiple ballrooms and event spaces suitable for weddings ranging from intimate gatherings to large celebrations. Both hotels offer comprehensive wedding packages including bridal suite stays, wedding decorations, food tasting, and various complimentary inclusions. Village Hotel Changi features the Square Ballroom and poolside solemnisation venue, while Village Hotel Katong offers the Saffron Ballroom and Alfresco space.

name: Village Hotel Katong
description: Village Hotel Katong and Village Hotel Changi are wedding venues under Far East Hospitality offering the Eternal Vows and Timeless Union wedding packages. They offer both Chinese and Western banquet options for lunch and dinner, with multiple ballroom options to suit different guest capacities. The venues provide comprehensive wedding packages including décor, beverages, accommodation, and planning support.

name: Village Hotel Sentosa
description: Far East Hospitality offers multiple wedding venues on Sentosa Island, including The Aloes Ballroom at Oasia Resort Sentosa, Revelry Hall at The Outpost Hotel Sentosa, and The Commune at Village Hotel Sentosa. The venues offer both weekday and weekend rates, with packages applicable for weddings held by 31 December 2026 (extended to 31 March 2027). Each venue includes comprehensive wedding packages with dining, beverages, decorations, and hotel stays. All venues are wheelchair accessible and offer individually plated menus with Chinese/Western cuisine options.

name: Vineyard At Hort Park
description: Vineyard is a French-Italian countryside-inspired restaurant nestled within the lush greenery of HortPark, offering a one-of-a-kind setting for wedding events. Surrounded by themed gardens, the venue provides an intimate and elegant backdrop for weddings ranging from intimate ceremonies to grand receptions. The venue features an Indoor Dining Hall, an Air-Conditioned Verandah, and an outdoor Patio with a reflecting infinity pool. The restaurant blends refined French cuisine with local and regional ingredients.

name: Voco Orchard Singapore
description: voco Orchard Singapore by IHG is a wedding venue located at 581 Orchard Road, Singapore. The hotel offers multiple elegant ballrooms for weddings, including the Grand Ballroom, Vista Room, and Panorama Room. The Grand Ballroom features abstract carpeted flooring, soft cream interior, and stunning floor-to-ceiling windows with elegant chandeliers. The Vista Room is awash with sunlight through floor-to-ceiling windows and sparkling chandeliers. The rooftop Panorama Room offers a six-metre ceiling height and a panoramic 180-degree view of Singapore's cityscape. The venue offers themed wedding decor options including Closer To Nature, Rustic Charm, Radiant Romance, Hues of Love, and Backyard Botanicals.

name: Vue
address: OUE Bayfront, 50 Collyer Quay, Level 19, Singapore 049321
description: VUE Bar & Grill is a Michelin-selected restaurant located on Level 19 of OUE Bayfront, offering breathtaking skyline views of Marina Bay and the Esplanade. The venue features a bold and innovative take on traditional grilled dishes by Executive Chef Sam Chin, who has over 15 years of culinary experience. VUE elevates every occasion with refined cuisine, stunning scenery, and impeccable service, making it ideal for corporate functions and intimate celebrations alike. The venue holds multiple accolades including Epicurean Star Award Singapore 2024, Tatler Best 2025, Wine Spectator Best of Award of Excellence 2024, and Michelin 2025.

rooms.room_name: Full Venue - Main Dining Hall + The Pavilion Bar

name: Wheeler's Tropikana
description: Wheeler's Tropikana is a tropical-themed wedding venue located at Gillman Barracks, Singapore. Inspired by the idyllic landscapes of Bali, this sensory venue features clay-themed hues and meticulously curated furnishings, providing a sanctuary where colours, textures, and ambiance come together to create an escape that feels like a distant paradise. The venue offers multiple event spaces including a Level 1 Alfresco area with a fully equipped stage, a Level 2 Indoor air-conditioned space with a sprawling tropical mural, an outdoor Pool Lawn area, and a Heaven's Gate solemnisation area. Perfect for intimate soirées or larger celebrations, the venue can host up to 230 guests across all spaces.

name: York Hotel Singapore
description: At York Hotel Singapore, weddings are a timeless and magical affair, with grand receptions unfolding in the elegant setting of our function venues. With an array of charming venues to choose from, your celebration is made even more special by our gracious service and a thoughtfully curated selection of exquisite menus crafted by our culinary team. The hotel offers dedicated wedding specialists and can accommodate up to 42 tables for wedding banquets.

name: Ywca Fort Canning
description: YWCA Fort Canning is a wedding venue located in a beautiful urban sanctuary in Singapore. All net proceeds go towards funding YWCA's community service programmes. The venue offers multiple event spaces including the Sophia Cooke Ballroom and Peace Room, with options for Chinese, Western, and Buffet menus. The pillarless Sophia Cooke Ballroom features full-glass windows and a ceiling height of 5.4 metres with a dedicated pre-function foyer. The Peace Room overlooks an outdoor swimming pool and is ideal for intimate weddings.
